title: Scottish Sword Dance Tutorial - Cultural Episode

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The teachers provide clear, step-by-step verbal explanations paired with physical demonstrations alongside beginners. They break down footwork and arm positions methodically before practicing with counts and music.

lesson_structure.note: Teachers introduce themselves and the dance
Demonstration of the sword dance step
Practicing the steps together with counts
Explanation of repetition around the sword

steps_taught.name: Patty-paw
steps_taught.description: Extend foot to the side, hop, and meet back foot.

steps_taught.name: Side-toe front-toe
steps_taught.description: Point foot to second position, then third and fourth positions over the swords.

what_works: Clear verbal breakdown of foot and arm positions
Having beginner participants model the learning process
what_hinders: Fast transitions between steps without slow repetition

quotes.text: Today we're going to be teaching you the second step of the sword dance.
Basically what happens there is you're just going to extend your foot to the side.
You basically just repeat that whole thing four times until you get back to the top of the sword.

evidence_segments.observation: Two instructors standing side by side introducing the lesson.
Instructors demonstrating the dance over crossed swords to music.

extraction.distinctive_method: Integrating cultural pavilion guests as live students during the tutorial to demonstrate learning progression.
